'''Mossol''', also known as '''Mossol the Menace''', was a member of [[Swang]]'s [[Swang's Swoopers|swoop gang]]. Mossol led the gang in the kidnapping of [[Diew Rejeff]],<ref name="Perdition" /> and during the [[Rebellion on Tatooine]].<ref name="Sand">{{WEGCite|book=Mos Eisley Adventure Set|story=A Line in the Sand...}}</ref>
